crosswalks.label: Penetration Testers
crosswalks.rationale: O*NET 31.0 directly defines Penetration Testers as conducting simulated cyberattacks to assess system security.

crosswalks.label: Vulnerability Analysis
crosswalks.rationale: NICE vulnerability-analysis work provides task/knowledge/skill context; explicit penetration-test authorization remains separate.

findings.summary: Penetration Testing requires exact authorization/scope and must separate observed exploitability from global security claims, data access from consent, and findings from risk acceptance.
findings.rationale: Research-backed boundary is compiled into package-local machinery.

gaps_against_body.description: Make authorization, safety-stop, sensitive-data and negative-result truth boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Penetration Tester reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No technical access, package construction, role label, model capability or repository permission creates legal, security, safety, privacy, risk, product or institutional authority.
